summary: Proposed narrow final revision. No tests were executed. Edits: (1) the plan-tamper diagnostic now explicitly mentions case order, so the existing order-swap test sees 'order' while the full-plan equality check remains strict; (2) _direction_report accepts integrity_ok and reports pass=false with an explicit integrity/provisional reason while retaining numeric comparison evidence; (3) analyze computes input_unchanged before the verdict and folds it plus no failed/missing across all 88 cases into integrity_ok, with per-boot/direction final pass gated on that integrity; (4) old modules are untouched; (5) a small AnalyzeTest case was added showing a short-case technical failure blocks method claims. Assumptions: by_status is initialized with failed/missing keys; existing _direction_report callers can keep using the default integrity_ok=True; no new production functions were introduced. Acceptance checks: updated order-swap test observes 'order' and plan.verified false; new short-failure test observes per-boot pass false, direction pass_both_boots false, cross_direction false, and strong_baseline still present; complete scientifically negative runs still exit 0 because incomplete remains technical-only.

    def test_short_technical_failure_blocks_method_claims(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as tmp:
            base, plan, selection = self._build_input(tmp)
            boot_ids = ("boot-a", "boot-b")
            rows = []
            for boot, rounds in ((1, (1, 2, 3)), (2, (4, 5, 6))):
                for round_index in rounds:
                    for method in method88.METHODS:
                        rows.append((boot, round_index, method,
                                     200 if method == "p5" else 100))
            self._populate(base, plan, rows, boot_ids, direction=0)
            self._populate(base, plan, rows, boot_ids, direction=1)
            short = self._case_of(plan, 1, 0, "unlimited", 0)
            self._populate(base, plan, [(1, 0, "unlimited", 100)], boot_ids)
            metadata_path = base / "runs" / short["id"] / "metadata.json"
            metadata = json.loads(metadata_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
            metadata["exit"] = 1
            metadata_path.write_text(json.dumps(metadata), encoding="utf-8")
            report = method88.analyze(str(base), str(pathlib.Path(tmp) / "out"))
            self.assertEqual(report["summary"]["failed"], 1)
            for direction in (0, 1):
                boot_entry = report["comparisons"]["per_boot_direction"]["1"][str(direction)]
                self.assertFalse(boot_entry["pass"])
                self.assertIn("integrity", boot_entry["reason"])
                self.assertIsNotNone(boot_entry["strong_baseline"])
                self.assertFalse(
                    report["comparisons"]["direction_verdicts"][str(direction)]["pass_both_boots"])
            self.assertFalse(report["comparisons"]["cross_direction"]["pass"])
